about.title: About the Lost Thunder set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Lost Thunder is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 2 November 2018. It has 236 cards: 214 in the main set and 22 secret rares. There are also 174 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 214 main set cards), the Master set (388 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 410 cards, adding the 22 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
